title: 第23章 污蔑他污蔑我啊第24章 你敢威胁我
content_zh:
陈观楼缓缓回过头，心头莫名有点发虚。
恐惧来源于未知。
关于最深处那间牢房，狱卒之间说法很多，却没有一个人能说到关键点。他曾偷偷打听过案子，却一无所获。据说那人被关押了几十年，估摸着案卷都弄没了。
他下意识咽了口唾沫，本该离开的他，鬼使神差，有种强烈的好奇心驱使着他朝最深处走去。
“你……”
四肢都被铁链锁住的犯人，杂乱的头发胡须遮掩下，一双眼睛显得格外幽深。漫长的牢狱岁月，并没有令他心智崩溃，他明显还保持着理智，拥有着成年人的智慧。
或许是长久不说话，他的嗓子仿佛是生锈的铁门，每发出一个音，都在摩擦着咽喉肌肉，嘶哑又暗沉，给人阴森森的感觉，和牢房的气氛很配，让人感觉很不舒服。
“你……明明没有武脉，为何能修习内功心法。”大胡子犯人想不通，双眼透着疑惑，他将陈观楼上下打量，得出一个肯定的结论，“你身上有古怪。”
陈观楼心头一惊，好犀利的犯人。
他板着脸，当然不肯承认自己有古怪，却也没有斥责对方。他拿不准对方来历背景，为什么关在天牢这么多年没人理会。外面的人似乎早已经将他忘记了，唯有天牢丙字号大牢的狱卒记得有他这号人物存在。
“你走近些，让我看看。”
陈观楼站着没动，大胡子犯人却动了，他扯动铁链，猛地扑向牢房栅栏，突然哈哈一笑。
陈观楼正好奇对方在笑什么，万万没想到，对方竟突然对他出手，出手就是杀招。陈观楼差点懵了，好还在他反应迅猛，提棍格挡，直接就是刀法里面的杀招。
他用尽了全力，堪堪走过三招，不得不连连后退，避开大胡子犯人的攻击。、
“好好好！你没有武脉，却能在我手底下走过三招，不得了。你的身上果然有古怪。”
陈观楼深吸一口气，压下心中的慌乱和惊讶。
习武以来，刚才的三招是他真正意义上和人第一次对敌比试。对自己的武艺有了个初步的认知，在武者面前，他就是个渣渣啊。真令人灰心丧气。
大胡子犯人还在喋喋不休，“你没武脉，却能修习上乘内功心法，还没有爆体而亡，活生生的站在老夫面前，看样子你的身体也很健康，并没有因为修习内功心法而受伤。古怪，真是古怪！”
陈观楼心头咯噔一声，“你看得出来？”
“哈哈哈……你果然修习了上乘内功心法。”

“你诈我。”
“兵不厌诈。小子，你到底有什么古怪。没有武脉，却能修习上乘内功心法，还不死的人，你是第一人，活生生的第一人。”
陈观楼沉默片刻，突然拱手行礼，态度极为恭敬，“敢问前辈几品？”
大胡子犯人嘿嘿一笑，“老夫刚进来时，五品。现在嘛，约等于三品。”
陈观楼惊疑不定，他竟然能在三品强者面前走过三招，这……他能夸夸自己嘛，真乃练武奇才。老天爷不给他武脉，绝对是眼瞎了。
content_en:
Chen Guanlou slowly turned around, feeling a little weak for no reason.
Fear comes from the unknown.
Regarding the deepest cell, the jailers had many opinions, but no one could talk about the key points. He once secretly inquired about the case, but found nothing. It was said that the man had been imprisoned for decades, and the case files were probably lost.
He swallowed subconsciously. He was supposed to leave, but somehow, a strong curiosity drove him towards the deepest part.
"You..."
The prisoner's limbs were chained, and his eyes looked particularly deep under his messy hair and beard. The long years in prison did not break his mind. He obviously still maintained his sanity and possessed the wisdom of an adult.
Perhaps because he had not spoken for a long time, his voice was like a rusty iron door. Every sound he made was rubbing against his throat muscles. It was hoarse and dark, giving people an eerie feeling. It matched the atmosphere of the cell and made people feel very uncomfortable.
"You...you clearly have no martial arts, how can you practice internal skills and mental methods." The bearded prisoner couldn't figure it out, his eyes were filled with doubts. He looked Chen Guanlou up and down and came to a definite conclusion, "There is something weird about you."
Chen Guanlou was shocked, what a sharp prisoner.
He had a straight face, and of course he refused to admit that he was weird, but he didn't rebuke the other party either. He was not sure about the other party's background and why he had been in jail for so many years and no one cared about him. People outside seemed to have forgotten him long ago. Only the jailer in Cell No. C remembered that a person like him existed.
"Come closer and let me see."
Chen Guanlou stood still, but the bearded prisoner moved. He pulled the chain, rushed towards the cell fence, and suddenly laughed.
Chen Guanlou was just wondering what the other party was laughing at, but he never expected that the other party would suddenly attack him with a killing move. Chen Guanlou was almost stunned, but fortunately, he reacted quickly and raised his stick to block, which was directly the killing move in the sword technique.
He tried his best and could barely survive three attacks, but had to retreat continuously to avoid the bearded prisoner's attack. ,
"Okay, okay! You have no martial arts, but you can survive three moves under my hands. It's incredible. There is indeed something weird about you."
Chen Guanlou took a deep breath to suppress the panic and surprise in his heart.
Since he started practicing martial arts, the three moves just now were his first real competition with an opponent. He has a preliminary understanding of his own martial arts. In front of warriors, he is just a scumbag. It's so discouraging.
The bearded prisoner was still chattering, "You have no martial arts, but you can practice superior internal skills and mental skills. You haven't exploded and died. You are standing in front of me alive. It seems that your body is also very healthy and you have not been injured by practicing internal skills and mental skills. Weird, really weird!"
Chen Guanlou's heart skipped a beat, "Can you tell?"
"Hahaha...you have indeed practiced the superior internal skills and mental methods."
"You lied to me."
"Soldiers never tire of deceit. Boy, what's so weird about you? You have no martial arts background, but you can practice superior internal skills and mental methods. You are the first person who is not dead. You are the first person alive."
Chen Guanlou was silent for a moment, then suddenly raised his hands in salute with a very respectful attitude, "May I ask your senior rank?"
The bearded prisoner chuckled, "When I first came in, it was level five. Now, it's about level three."
Chen Guanlou was shocked and doubtful. He could actually perform three moves in front of a third-grade strong man. This... he could boast about himself. He was really a martial arts genius. If God doesn't give him martial arts, he is definitely blind.
